name: Render and save a PNG through the Blender GUI
description: GUI version of the render-to-PNG task: opens the project in the Blender window, renders with F12, saves via Image > Save As in the render window. Demonstrates hotkeys, OCR-based verification and a manual step for Blender's non-native file browser. Prefer blender/render-png (headless) unless the user wants to watch.
triggers: render and save image in blender window

hints.notes: A separate 'Blender Render' window opens; wait until rendering finishes (the title or header shows the frame time).

steps.title: Save the render as PNG
steps.manual: In the render window open Image > Save As (shortcut shift+alt+s). Blender uses its own file browser, not a native dialog: double-click the file path field at the top, select all (mod+a), type {{output_path}}, press Enter, ensure the file format is PNG, then press Enter / click 'Save As Image'.

failure_modes.recovery: Hotkeys go to the area under the mouse: move the mouse over the 3D viewport (input_mouse move) and press F12 again, or use the Render menu (ui_menu ['Render', 'Render Image'] with method visual).

failure_modes.symptom: No 'Save As' in the image menu
failure_modes.recovery: In older versions it is under Image > Save As Image; use F3 search and type 'save as'.
